info.name: Glimpse
info.summary: Find photos by what is in them: content and face search, timeline, map and people, powered by Immich
info.description:
**Find any photo in your Nextcloud by what is in it.** Type "dog in the snow", "birthday cake" or a person's name, and Glimpse finds the picture, among the files you already keep in Nextcloud. The image understanding (CLIP), face recognition, memories and duplicate detection come from a self-hosted [Immich](https://immich.app) that indexes your Nextcloud files read-only. Nextcloud still decides who sees what.
### Search - **By content**: describe the picture, results are ranked by meaning, not by file names or tags. - **Inside videos**: finds moments in videos by what is in them, jumping straight to the scene. - **By person**, or both at once: "Alex beach" finds Alex's beach pictures. - Filter by tag, photos or videos; "More like this" for any picture. - Also in Nextcloud's own search bar and in the Nextcloud mobile apps.
### Browse - **Timeline** in year bands with a year rail, "On this day" and "Back to today". - **Map** of geotagged pictures (tiles proxied by your server). - **Folders** as galleries, **duplicates** with Immich's suggestion of what to keep.
### People Name, merge, hide and favorite people; assign single faces or correct many at once; "Label people" names them in a row. Faces are cut only from pictures the viewer may open.
### Viewer Below an open picture, as in the Android app: share, favorite, similar, delete, and an info sheet with date, the people in it, its folder, download, move, copy, album and tag.
### Sort in bulk Select many (long-press on touch), then move or copy into folders with undo, tag, favorite, add to a Photos album and share it, download as ZIP, or delete.
### Private area Folders, people and single pictures that only appear after unlocking with your password, and never in the global search or on the dashboard.
### Nextcloud permissions decide One shared index, but every user only ever sees files they can open in Nextcloud: their own and those shared with them. Thumbnails, faces, map markers, memories and duplicates are checked the same way.
### Everywhere in Nextcloud A "Similar pictures" action and a "People" tab in Files, an "On this day" dashboard widget, and a native [Android app](https://github.com/Infraviored/glimpse-android).
**Requirements:** a self-hosted Immich with its machine-learning service, read-only access for Immich to the Nextcloud data directory, Nextcloud cron, and ffmpeg on the Nextcloud server (for search inside videos). Setup guide: [README](https://github.com/Infraviored/nextcloud-immich-search#install).
info.author: Florian Schneider
